Open the application entry URL.
The home page is displayed with the `Notes workspace` region, the `Take a note` button, and the `Search` textbox visible.

cases.name: Note Listing
cases.description: Display the notes list on the home page with pinned notes shown separately from unpinned notes. The pinned section is a named region or heading `Pinned`, and the regular section is a named region or heading `Others`. Each note is exposed as a unique article named by its title. Seed data: pinned note "Sprint goals" and regular note "Groceries".

steps.content: User has opened the application and the system is accessible.
View the home page.
The page displays visible `Pinned` and `Others` sections, with `Sprint goals` in the pinned section and `Groceries` in the regular section.

cases.name: Create Note
cases.description: Create a note from the `Take a note` button. Activating it opens exactly one dialog named `Note editor` containing uniquely labelled textboxes `Title` and `Note content`, plus a button named `Close`. Closing the dialog autosaves the note. Take a note form from homepage image: ![image](./reference/create_note_home_page.png) Note form image: ![image](./reference/create_note_form.png)

steps.content: User is on the home page.

Activate the unique button `Take a note`, fill the `Title` textbox with `Weekend plan`, fill the `Note content` textbox with `Visit the farmers market and prep lunches.`, and activate the `Close` button in the `Note editor` dialog.
The `Note editor` dialog closes, the note is autosaved, and exactly one note article named `Weekend plan` appears in the notes list.

baseline.title: REQ-2.2: Create Note

cases.name: Delete
cases.description: Delete a note from its actions without an extra confirmation dialog. Each note is an article containing a button named `More options`; activating it exposes a button named `Delete Note` scoped to that note. Deletion exposes a status message `Note trashed` and a button named `Undo`. Dropdown image: ![image](./reference/note_more_options_dropdown.png) Seed data: deletable note "Delete me 2.3.1".

steps.content: User is on the home page and can see at least one note.
Hover over the article for `Delete me 2.3.1`, activate its `More options` button, and activate its `Delete Note` button.
The `Delete me 2.3.1` article is absent from the main notes list, a visible status message displays exactly `Note trashed`, and a unique button named `Undo` is available.

cases.name: Notification and Undo
cases.description: Show a delete status notification with a unique `Undo` button after a note is deleted. Activating `Undo` restores the same note article and displays a status message exactly `Action undone`. Reference image for notification: ![image](./reference/note_delete_notification.png) Seed data: deletable note "Delete me 2.3.2".

steps.content: User has just deleted a note from the home page.
Activate the unique `Undo` button in the visible delete notification.
The `Delete me 2.3.2` note article is restored and the page shows a visible status message exactly `Action undone`.

cases.name: Trash list
cases.description: Open the Trash view from the sidebar and display deleted notes. The sidebar is exposed as a complementary landmark and contains a unique button named `Trash`. Reference image: ![image](./reference/trash_list.png) Seed data: deletable note "Delete me 2.3.3".

steps.content: User can see the sidebar.
Activate the unique button named `Trash` in the sidebar.
The Trash view displays the deleted note article named `Delete me 2.3.3`.

baseline.title: REQ-2.3.3: Trash list

cases.name: Update Note
cases.description: Edit the content of an existing note and persist it after closing the editor. Activating the note article opens a dialog named `Note editor` containing a textbox named `Note content` and a button named `Close`. Reference image: ![image](./reference/note_editing.png) Seed data: note "Project ideas" with initial content "Initial editable content".

steps.content: User is on the home page and can see a note.
Open the `Project ideas` note article, replace `Note content` with `Updated editable content for the note editor.`, and activate `Close`.
The `Note editor` dialog closes and the `Project ideas` article displays `Updated editable content for the note editor.`.

cases.name: Archive
cases.description: Archive a note using the button named `Archive` inside its note article and show a status message exactly `Note archived` with a unique `Undo` button. Reference image: ![image](./reference/archive_button.png) Seed data: active note "Travel plans 2.5.1".

steps.content: User is on the home page and can see a note.
Activate the `Archive` button inside the `Travel plans 2.5.1` note article.
The note is absent from the main list, is stored in the archive list, and the page shows `Note archived` with a unique `Undo` button.

baseline.title: REQ-2.5.1: Archive

cases.name: Archive Undo
cases.description: Restore an archived note by using the Undo action from the archive notification. Seed data: active note "Travel plans 2.5.2".

steps.content: The archive notification is visible after archiving a note.
Activate the unique `Undo` button in the archive notification.
The note article named `Travel plans 2.5.2` returns to the main notes list.

baseline.title: REQ-2.5.2: Archive Undo

cases.name: Show archived notes
cases.description: Open the Archive view from the sidebar using the unique button named `Archive` and display archived note articles. Reference image: ![image](./reference/archived_notes_page.png) Seed data: active note "Travel plans 2.5.3".

steps.content: User can see the sidebar.
Activate the unique `Archive` button in the sidebar.
The Archive view displays the note article named `Travel plans 2.5.3`.

baseline.title: REQ-2.5.3: Show archived notes

cases.name: Unarchive
cases.description: Restore an archived note using the button named `Unarchive` inside its note article. Reference image: ![image](./reference/unarchive_button.png) Seed data: active note "Travel plans 2.5.4".

steps.content: User is viewing the archived notes list.
Activate the `Unarchive` button inside the `Travel plans 2.5.4` article.
The note is absent from the archived list and the `Travel plans 2.5.4` article is present in the main notes list.

baseline.title: REQ-2.5.4: Unarchive

cases.name: Change note color
cases.description: Change the color of an existing note using its `Change color` button and a color button named `Light green`. Light green is represented by computed background color `rgb(204, 255, 144)`. Seed data: regular note "Garden tasks existing" with a white background.

steps.content: User is on the home page and can see a note.
Activate `Change color` in the `Garden tasks existing` article and activate the color button named `Light green`.
The note article background changes to computed color `rgb(204, 255, 144)`.

cases.name: Choose note color when created
cases.description: Set the color of a note during creation using the `Change color` and `Light green` buttons in the `Note editor` dialog.

steps.content: User has opened the "Take a note" editor.
Activate `Change color`, activate `Light green`, fill `Title` with `Garden tasks created`, fill `Note content` with `Color me later`, and activate `Close`.
The `Garden tasks created` note article is saved with computed background color `rgb(204, 255, 144)`.

baseline.title: REQ-2.6.2: Choose note color when created

cases.name: Default label
cases.description: Provide `Reminders` as a default label in the sidebar. The sidebar exposes it as a unique button named `Reminders`. Seed data: default label "Reminders".

steps.content: The system has been initialized.
View the labels list.
The sidebar includes a unique button named `Reminders`.

cases.name: Assign default label when creating note
cases.description: Assign the default "Reminders" label during note creation. Seed data: default label "Reminders".

scenarios.name: Assign default label when creating note

Open "More options", choose "Change labels", select the "Reminders" label, enter a title and content, and click "Close".
The created note is saved with the "Reminders" label.

baseline.title: REQ-2.7.4: Assign default label when creating note

cases.name: Edit labels
cases.description: Create, rename, and delete labels from the label management list. Each label row is a named group, for example `Label Work editable`, containing a textbox labelled `Label Work editable` and a unique `Save` button. The label list contains a textbox named `Label Projects`.

cases.name: View list filtered by label
cases.description: Filter the notes list by a selected label. The sidebar exposes the label as a unique button named `Work`. Seed data: note "Design review" with the "Work" label and note "Movie list" without the "Work" or "Reminders" label; label "Work".

steps.content: User can see the sidebar.
Activate the unique `Work` button in the sidebar.
The notes list contains `Design review` and does not contain `Movie list`.

baseline.title: REQ-2.7.6.1: View list filtered by label

cases.name: View all notes
cases.description: Return from a label-filtered view to the full notes list. Seed data: note "Design review" with the "Work" label and note "Movie list" without the "Work" or "Reminders" label; label "Work".

steps.content: User can see the sidebar.
Activate the unique `Notes` button in the sidebar.
The notes list contains both `Design review` and `Movie list`.

cases.name: View Reminders
cases.description: Filter the notes list by the default "Reminders" label. Seed data: note "Call dentist existing" with the "Reminders" label and note "Movie list" without the "Work" or "Reminders" label; label "Reminders".

steps.content: User can see the sidebar.
Activate the unique `Reminders` button in the sidebar.
The notes list contains `Call dentist existing` and does not contain `Movie list`.

cases.name: Pin note
cases.description: Pin an existing note from its article using a button named `Pin note`. The pinned article exposes a title attribute `Pinned`. Reference image: ![image](./reference/pin_button.png) Seed data: regular note "Meeting agenda 2.8.1" that is not pinned.

steps.content: User is on the home page and can see a note.
Activate the `Pin note` button inside the `Meeting agenda 2.8.1` article.
The article has title `Pinned` and appears in the `Pinned` section.

cases.name: Unpin note
cases.description: Remove the pinned state from a pinned note using its `Unpin note` button. The article no longer exposes title `Pinned`. Seed data: regular note "Meeting agenda 2.8.2" that is not pinned.

steps.content: User is on the home page and the note is pinned.
Activate the `Unpin note` button inside the `Meeting agenda 2.8.2` article.
The article is absent from the pinned section, is present in the regular notes list, and has no `Pinned` title.

cases.name: Pin note when creating it
cases.description: Create a note in the pinned state. The `Note editor` dialog contains a button named `Pin note` and a button named `Close`.

steps.content: User is on the home page and the "Take a note" editor is open.
Fill `Title` with `Meeting agenda created`, fill `Note content` with `Pin this note`, activate `Pin note`, and activate `Close`.
The `Meeting agenda created` article is displayed in `Pinned` and exposes title `Pinned`.

baseline.title: REQ-2.8.3: Pin note when creating it

cases.name: Log In Successfully
cases.description: Authenticate with valid credentials and enter the authenticated homepage state. Seed data: verified account with nickname "BookStack User", email "bookstack_user@example.com", and password "Password123!".
